title: Fit-for-purpose, affordable body-powered prostheses

image.alt: Upper limb body powered prosthesis consisting of a hand and an arm that has two sections joined by a mechanical elbow. The arm section is made of a dark brow plastic material while the hand is covered by a sleeve that has a much lighter color, this contrast of colors is one of the reasons prosthetics users reject their prostheses.

resources.label: overview of the findings of this project here.

summary: Research into affordable upper-limb prostheses whose design responds to users’ activities and the environments in which they live.
